_comment: The production image of this repository and what it is made of (atrium-project#72 A.3).
Checked on every push by the hub's workflow-lint.reusable.yml (tools/ci/image_closure.py):
every first-party file the entrypoint can execute must be listed here or be a hub-canonical
shared component (docs/templates/shared/MANIFEST.json); a listed file it no longer reaches
fails too. Run it locally with: python ../atrium-project/tools/ci/image_closure.py
converts a born-digital file into an atrium_document record and calls nothing; POST
/describe adds the per-page report and calls page-classification and ocr-postprocess when
their URLs are set (service/stages.py). The keyword code that used to be this image left
for atrium-keyword-extract (#1; transfer manifest in agent_dev_logs/digests/1.digest.md).
`digital` is the converter's CLI (published, never pinned); `digital-docling` is a local
build. The api_util/*_md.py files are the record -> Markdown renderer `/reformat` serves
with markdown=true; keyword-extract vendors it with SHA pins (#72 B). text_formats.py is
tests/test_vendored_reader_parity.py; teitok_read.py and bbox_scale.py are nlp-enrich's,
stage: born-digital conversion: POST /reformat (file -> atrium_document record), POST /describe (+ per-page report)
